summary: Connect resident Alpha Teaching caller to the issued Training worker principal and omit conflicting caller-declared actor id so the Training owner derives trusted subject training-session-preview-worker while preserving Alpha research provenance in context_refs and trace_id.

defect_context.symptom: On Source15 admission adm-603bc7ce2b19 and completed research run erun-alpha-88580c28ee139dce, Alpha revalidation worker failed at Teaching caller with HTTP 401 Unauthorized missing Bearer token because docker-compose.yml lacked ALPHA_REPLICATION_TRAINING_SERVICE_TOKEN_FILE input and scripts/issue_dev_paper_principals.py CONSUMER_FILES omitted TRAINING_SESSION_WORKER_TOKEN for alpha-replication-worker. Furthermore, Alpha _invoke_persona_teaching declared actor_id=self._worker_id ('alpha-revalidation-worker'), which caused Training _trusted_actor_id to fail with HTTP 403 Forbidden because declared actor did not match verified token subject ('training-session-preview-worker').
defect_context.resolution: Distributed TRAINING_SESSION_WORKER_TOKEN to alpha-replication-worker in CONSUMER_FILES, bound ALPHA_REPLICATION_TRAINING_SERVICE_TOKEN_FILE to /run/pantheon-principals/TRAINING_SESSION_WORKER_TOKEN in docker-compose.yml, and omitted declared actor_id from the Alpha create teaching payload so Training derives trusted actor training-session-preview-worker while retaining Alpha provenance in context_refs, run_id, and trace_id.

acceptance_verification.ac1_token_distribution_and_compose_input: passed: Delivered already-issued TRAINING_SESSION_WORKER_TOKEN to Alpha through original issuer CONSUMER_FILES distribution, existing read-only volume dev-paper-alpha-replication-tokens:/run/pantheon-principals:ro, and ALPHA_REPLICATION_TRAINING_SERVICE_TOKEN_FILE Compose input without minting new credentials or weakening roles.
acceptance_verification.ac2_training_principal_usage_and_omitted: passed: Used verified Training principal at Alpha Teaching create and GET boundaries; omitted conflicting caller-declared actor so Training derives trusted subject training-session-preview-worker while retaining Alpha provenance in Research tasks, runs, trace_id, and context_refs.
acceptance_verification.ac3_focused_original_tests: passed: scripts/test_issue_dev_paper_principals.py verifies consumer file distribution, claims, and Compose binding; services/research/alpha_replication/test_revalidation_worker.py verifies generated Alpha create payload accepted by real Training inbound authority with locally issued signed token, readback opened_by derivation, loop record recording, and negative contracts (mismatched actor 403, missing token 401, foreign tenant 403, token rotation).
acceptance_verification.ac4_source_only_delivery_boundaries: pending_delivery: Changes restricted to 3 production files, 2 test files, and 1 evidence file on per-task branch task/ALPHA-TEACHING-PRINCIPAL-WIRING-20261016. Preserved source-vs-hosted boundaries; no queue tampering or manual task JSON editing.

test_expectation_classification.details: All 41 issuer tests, 19 renewal tests, and 23 revalidation worker tests pass without weakening existing assertions. Added new unit and owner-contract tests in test_issue_dev_paper_principals.py and test_revalidation_worker.py.
